Searched Coqui/coqui.AI funding, early 2021/2022 rounds, convertible notes, grants and later shutdown coverage; fetched the SEC filing/submissions, Forbes, ScaleX portfolio, PitchBook, CB Insights and filing aggregator. SEC calls the instrument an option to acquire securities; CB Insights classifies it as Convertible Note and explicitly maps Mango Capital to that round and its January 2023 Convertible Note II. Mango is not inferred from the March round. January 2023 has no public amount; no $500,000 difference was imputed from cumulative totals. March 2023 $3.3M and three firms are reported by Forbes; seed label follows investor ScaleX rather than databases calling it Series A; no lead or unnamed angels invented. Incomplete: the January 2023 note is a database-only disclosed event lacking independent confirmation or proof it is economically separate from the March financing. Low-confidence row retained for review; shutdown is excluded.
